success_checker: contracts.py piper_contracts_v1; all grasp/move/place and handoff predicates must pass

seen_distribution_heldout_seeds.definition: 10 frozen test seeds x 3 policy noise seeds

new_position.definition: new reset seeds 5000-5029 in current supported XY +/-2.5cm envelope

new_object_or_appearance.definition: not yet implemented; freeze object/appearance scene variants and safety scope before trials

runtime.mode: synchronous_paused_simulation; not evidence of real-time scheduling
runtime.invalid_action: reject entire chunk and terminate; no clipping
runtime.termination: task success, timeout, invalid action, interruption, or step budget; clear queue and reset model

checkpoint_selection: validation only; lowest finite validation loss is a candidate, retain checkpoint only after heldout closed-loop gate; test never chooses checkpoint
subskills: candidate only; report N/A with n=0 until independent entry/exit and continuous learned handoff protocol is approved
real_robot_trials: not authorized or performed; separate hardware calibration and explicit authorization required
